verdict.line: You lose short trades when K'Sante has his W (Path Maker) stun and Q (Ntofo Strikes) pull both up; you win extended trades and the siege once Stridebreaker is online.

brief.thesis: This is a cooldown-window matchup, not a stat-check one: K'Sante's threat is spiky and tied to his Q (Ntofo Strikes) stack count and W (Path Maker) charge-and-dash, while Garen's threat is sustained AoE from E (Judgment) and W (Courage) that doesn't care about his own cooldowns. OP.GG calls the lane shape EVEN with K'Sante holding the solo-kill edge, but the 55.7% head-to-head over 3,078 games says Garen players who respect his all-in windows and punish the gaps between them win the lane comfortably.

theirWindow.when: W (Path Maker) and Q 2-stack both up
theirWindow.what: He can charge W into a knockback stun and follow with a 2-stack Q shockwave pull to lock you down for a full burst combo. Don't stand in a straight line in front of him when both are off cooldown — back off or circle so the Q (450 range, short line) can't land clean.

yourWindow.when: his W and E (Footwork) are both down
yourWindow.what: Without W (Path Maker)'s stun or E (Footwork)'s dash-shield, K'Sante has no defensive or engage tool left. Walk up and chain E (Judgment) into auto-attacks, saving Q (Decisive Strike)'s silence for if he tries to flash or fight back.

start.why: Taken 59.1% of the time at 56% win rate; the flat sustain blunts his Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke so you can stay in range to trade E (Judgment) back every time he pokes.

boots.why: 78.1% pick rate at 56.4% win rate — the attack speed lets your E and auto-attack trades keep pace with his lower Q cooldown (3.5s) instead of falling behind on DPS.

core.why: First item in the top path (60.9% win rate, 445 games); the active's slow and burst let you force a trade the moment his W (Path Maker) or E (Footwork) is down.
Second in the dominant build path; attack speed keeps your E (Judgment) and autos stacking damage through his Dauntless Instinct marks instead of trading evenly.
Closes the top path (19.1% pick); grievous wounds directly undercuts the healing he gets while All Out (R) is active.

situational.when: he's building toward a tankier All Out line and you need the armor shred to keep executing with your R
you need more durability to survive his W knockback-stun chain into the rest of his team
you're ahead and want to close the gap on him faster since his W charge-up telegraphs the engage

runes.keystoneWhy: Prolonged trades favor you once stacked — K'Sante's kit is burst-and-reset, so forcing extended exchanges with E (Judgment) spam builds Conqueror faster than he can punish it.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick (95.2% pick rate, 55.6% win rate); Ignite punishes his Footwork (E) sustain and secures kills once your R (Demacian Justice) brings him low.

playing.title: Trade with E, not Q
playing.detail: Lean on E (Judgment) for lane damage — its cooldown drops from 13s to 9s at max rank, letting you out-sustain his slower 3.5s Q (Ntofo Strikes) pokes over a long trade.

playing.title: Hold Q for his engage
playing.detail: Save Q (Decisive Strike)'s silence until he commits his W (Path Maker) dash, since silencing him mid-combo denies the follow-up E (Footwork) or R (All Out) he needs to finish the trade.

playing.title: Never stand in his Q line at 2 stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks his Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls you in — sidestep or disengage before he reaches that stack count instead of eating the pull into his stun.

playing.title: Punish his cooldown gaps
playing.detail: The moment W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) are both down, he has no stun and no escape — walk up and commit your full combo.

playing.title: Don't split push into cooldown Footwork
playing.detail: E (Footwork) gives him a dash-shield reset even at range 525 — don't overextend assuming he's immobile just because W is down.

playing.title: Track his All Out cooldown late
playing.detail: R (All Out) drops to a 20s cooldown at rank 5 — once it's up repeatedly, expect him to force fights since his kit transforms and heals while active; Mortal Reminder is your answer.

brief.patchCaveat: Item paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample-size figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the cooldown windows, trade timing, and tactical reads are my own analysis layered on top.
